title: Meet the Immortal Jellyfish
script: You can't kill this jellyfish. It has a special trick to stay alive. What if aging had a reset button? This jellyfish has one. It's called Turritopsis dohrnii. But how does it work? It transforms its own cells back into a baby polyp. But that's not even the strange part. It does this through transdifferentiation, essentially a butterfly turning back into a caterpillar. This makes it biologically immortal. You could watch every human civilization rise and fall many times over, and this jellyfish would still be alive. Try this: fill a glass with water and add a few drops of dish soap. Now, gently touch the surface with your finger. The soap breaks the surface tension, just like the jellyfish breaks the rules of aging. Save this so you remember it. You can't kill this jellyfish.
